title: UNVALIDATED TEMPLATE - Mosaic KrasG12D lineage-reporter lung adenocarcinoma initiation (mouse)

authored.author: IFQuant-Lung config track (D)
authored.notes: *** UNVALIDATED TEMPLATE. NOT AN ESTABLISHED PROFILE. *** Every numeric parameter is null or an explicit placeholder. The one thing this file is FOR is fixing the denominator argument before anyone images: in a mosaic model the natural denominator is the RECOMBINED (reporter+) compartment, not total tissue, because recombination efficiency varies between animals and total-tissue normalisation turns a tamoxifen-dose difference into a phenotype.

profile_validation.notes: TEMPLATE. 'unset' is the only honest value: no endpoint-critical parameter has a measured value, so the profile cannot claim any rung of the ladder. The generator recomputes this and would reject anything stronger.

insult.agent: Cre-mediated mosaic activation of KrasG12D with a lineage reporter (e.g. Red2 multicolour reporter)
insult.route: TEMPLATE - intratracheal or intranasal Cre-adenovirus/lentivirus, or tamoxifen for a CreERT2 allele. These are NOT the same model: viral Cre targets whichever cells the virus reaches, tamoxifen targets whichever cells carry the driver.

severity_readout.assay: TEMPLATE - recombination efficiency itself: reporter+ area or reporter+ cell count per mm2 in a NON-tumour region, measured on the same section.

status.notes: In a mosaic model this is the equivalent of the influenza NP assay. Without it, an animal that recombined twice as many cells looks like an animal with twice the tumour propensity.

cell_states.description: TEMPLATE - NKX2-1+/NAPSA+ pulmonary glandular lineage pattern.
cell_states.morphology_expectation: TEMPLATE - glandular/papillary architecture; architecture is what distinguishes adenoma from adenocarcinoma and no marker does it.

validation.evidence: lung_marker_registry.json research_profiles.lung_adenocarcinoma_lineage.caveat: the pipeline quantifies marker patterns; it does not diagnose malignancy or determine tumour origin.

validation.notes: The DISTRIBUTION is the endpoint, not the mean. A model that doubles the number of small clones and a model that doubles the size of a few clones give the same mean area and mean different biology.

primary_endpoint.statement: TEMPLATE - reporter+ lesion area divided by TOTAL RECOMBINED (reporter+) area on the same section. The denominator is deliberately the recombined compartment, not total tissue: recombination efficiency varies severalfold between animals, so a total-tissue denominator makes a tamoxifen or titre difference look like a tumour-propensity difference. This is the same logical move as normalising influenza pods to damaged rather than total area.
primary_endpoint.reference_method: TEMPLATE - most published mosaic-Kras quantification is lesion COUNT per section or lesion burden by H&E area; an IF reporter-area fraction is a different quantity.

numerator.description: TEMPLATE - requires areaMode 'pod' (or a lesion-size filter) rather than the example's areaMode 'reporter'; the distinction between 'any recombined pixel' and 'a lesion' IS the endpoint and must be a declared size/shape rule, not an accident of areaMinAreaUm2.

denominator.description: TEMPLATE - all reporter+ area, lesion or not.
denominator.why_not_total_tissue: Total tissue normalisation confounds tumour propensity with recombination efficiency.

aggregation.path: TEMPLATE - PROBLEM TO SOLVE BEFORE RUNNING: aggregate_to_mouse.py recomputes <marker>_positive_area_fraction against region_area_um2 and <marker>_pod_area_frac against region_area_um2 (aggregate_to_mouse.py:320,330). It does NOT compute a marker-over-marker ratio. Two legitimate options: (a) report BOTH pooled totals per mouse and form the ratio in the stats step from mouse_level_summary.csv columns RED2_KRAS_G12D_RFP_pod_area_um2_total and RED2_KRAS_G12D_RFP_positive_area_um2_total - both already exist and are SUMS, so no aggregator change is needed and no forking occurs; or (b) add ONE generic marker-over-marker ratio rule to aggregate_to_mouse.py that every model can use. Option (a) requires no change and is the default. Option (b) must be a single generic rule, never a kras-specific branch.

interpretation_limits: TEMPLATE - reporter+ does not prove the Kras allele recombined; reporter and allele recombine independently at some rate. State the assumed concordance or measure it.
TEMPLATE - a marker pattern is not a diagnosis of malignancy.

qc_endpoints.statement: TEMPLATE - reporter+ area fraction in UNINDUCED animals. This is the false-positive floor of the entire model.

denominator.why_not_total_tissue: TEMPLATE - total tissue IS correct here; leakiness is per unit lung.

interpretation_limits: TEMPLATE - a bright reporter with a low threshold reads leaky; this endpoint is the threshold's own specificity test.

controls.description: TEMPLATE - reporter allele present, no Cre induction.
does_not_control_for: antibody-independent autofluorescence in the reporter band from an induced, inflamed lung

controls.description: TEMPLATE - Cre and reporter without the KrasG12D allele.
controls_for: everything the recombination itself does, separated from what the oncogene does
does_not_control_for: differences in recombination efficiency between the two lines

controls.description: TEMPLATE - unstained section imaged at identical exposures.
controls_for: the autofluorescence floor in the reporter band, which is a genetically encoded fluorophore with no antibody amplification and therefore often close to that floor

confounds.mechanism: TEMPLATE - tamoxifen dose, viral titre, and delivery all change how many cells recombine. Tumour burden per lung scales with that, independent of any genotype effect on tumour biology.
confounds.orthogonal_assay_required: Reporter+ area in non-lesional tissue on the same section, as the denominator.

confounds.mechanism: TEMPLATE - reporter and KrasG12D recombine independently; reporter+ cells are not all Kras-mutant, and Kras-mutant cells are not all reporter+.
confounds.orthogonal_assay_required: Allele-specific genotyping or a mutant-specific stain on sorted or microdissected material.

confounds.mechanism: TEMPLATE - a genetically encoded fluorophore has no antibody amplification, so its signal-to-autofluorescence margin is much smaller than an immunostained marker's. custom_panels.example.json already applies thresholdSensitivity 0.60 to tdTOM channels as an acknowledgement of this.

forbidden_uses: TEMPLATE - do NOT tag a region 'tumor' using the reporter channel and then measure reporter area inside that tag. Circular. Tumour geography must come from architecture (DAPI density, brightfield H&E via the registration module) or from a human.
TEMPLATE - do NOT treat NKX2-1/NAPSA positivity as a malignancy call.

calibration_requirements.selection_rule: TEMPLATE - declare BEFORE looking. Suggested: smallest threshold whose reporter+ area fraction in UNINDUCED lung is <= alpha, worst-of-all-control-animals. Induced animals must not be opened.
TEMPLATE - what size makes a reporter+ patch a LESION rather than a recombined single cell? Fix on the Cre-only arm, where by definition no lesions exist, then apply unchanged.

validation.evidence: config/custom_panels.example.json is an EXAMPLE panel; idx values must match acquisition.

The env name is the engine's normalised token for RED2_KRAS_G12D_RFP: upper-case and strip every non-alphanumeric (IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:194, 877-880). Getting this string wrong is silent - envOr just falls back and the run goes adaptive.
Applies to the alias 'Ki-67' as well: a canonical threshold propagates to registry aliases (IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:881-886).

Engine pilot default 1.25 (IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:268). Only settable because the MKI67 rule already carries a minNuclearEnrichment key; the env override is skipped for rules that do not (IF_Quant_Pipeline.groovy:906-911).
config/custom_panels.example.json uses 8.0 as an explicitly flagged placeholder.
Timepoint folded into the condition token.
